taylor: Heads up — starting ~02:10 we saw a spike of OTLP HTTP exporter `RST_STREAM` and 5xxs after the nginx upstream pool change. Anyone else seeing this?

sam: yep, I saw it in traces. Most errors are "early timeout" from the collector exporter and `RST_STREAM` on the connection.

anjali: which exporter are we using in the collector? gRPC or otlphttp?

taylor: otlphttp (HTTP/2). we had gRPC fallback disabled in the collector for now.

lee: my hunch: LB connection rotation -> GOAWAYs -> collector retries aggressively -> retry storm. We should add a retry budget + per-target concurrency cap.

sam: also noticed the client isn't setting ALPN properly in some pods, causing HTTP/1.1 fallback which breaks keepalive semantics. check `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_PROTOCOL`.

infra-bot: ALERT: otlp-http-exporter error rate 5xx = 8.4% (5m) — affected collectors: 12

anjali: can we do a short circuit-breaker on exporter errors to avoid spamming upstream while LB rotates?

taylor: proposed plan: 1) soft circuit-breaker per-target, 2) token-bucket retry budget shared across exporter instances in a process, 3) jittered exp backoff with cap. Example config sketch:```retry:
  enabled: true
  initial_interval: 100ms
  max_interval: 2s
  max_elapsed_time: 30s
  per_target_budget: 10
  shared_bucket: 100
  jitter: 20%```

lee: that looks good. also add max concurrent requests per exporter to avoid head-of-line blocking.

sam: we should also reduce collector `exporter_timeout` from 10s -> 5s to fail fast on bad connections, but pair that with the retry budget so we don't amplify retries.

taylor: example collector snippet I will PR:```exporters:
  otlphttp:
    endpoint: https://telemetry.redwood-internal/api/otlp/v1/traces
    timeout: 5s
    headers:
      x-team: eng-platform
    retry:
      enabled: true
      initial_interval: 150ms
      max_interval: 2s
      max_elapsed_time: 20s
      shared_bucket: 80
      per_target_budget: 8
      jitter: 25%```

anjali: lowering timeouts can increase retry churn unless the budget prevents it — agree we must pair them.

devops: @sam @taylor we also have an infra side change: increase LB keepalive and improve drain behavior. We'll bump `keepalive_timeout` and make connection drains slower on deploy. See: https://deploys.redwood/notes/otlp-lb-plan (internal)

sam: thanks — that should cut most RSTs caused by premature closes. also validate ALPN in the sidecar image.

lee: let's add a collector metric `exporter.retry_budget_used` and a dashboard panel (per-region and per-exporter) so we can spot budget exhaustion.

taylor: I'll open a PR to add `otel.http.retry_budget` feature flag and config and enable it as a canary to 10%. Will include the collector config change + metrics.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout started — collectors v2.18.4-canary (10%); change: otel exporter retry budget + timeout tweak

anjali: extra note — retries can spike ingestion downstream. we need smoothing on the ingestor side (rate-limiter, write-backoff) to avoid compounding bursts.

taylor: will add `ingest.max_events_per_sec=20000` soft limit and retry smoothing on the ingestor; can raise if canary looks good.

sam: action items: taylor PR for collector + ingestor, infra to adjust LB keepalive/drain, lee dashboard and metrics, anjali to validate retention/ingest smoothing.

devops: LB plan assigned, ETA 4h for keepalive changes, will monitor.

lee: dashboard query draft: `sum(rate(exporter_retry_total[1m])) by (exporter,region) / sum(rate(exporter_request_total[1m])) by (exporter,region)` — add threshold alerts for >2% sustained and budget exhaustion.

taylor: I'll open the RFC doc and link in the PR: https://docs.redwood/infra/otlp-retries (work-in-progress).

sam: small reminder — also check problems with HTTP/2 window sizes and `MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS` defaults on our proxies. Could make head-of-line issues worse.

anjali: agreed. let's validate proxy settings in staging before full rollout.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: collectors v2.18.4-canary finished stage 1 (10%) — monitoring for 30m

lee: dashboard panel created and linked in the PR description.

anjali: I'll run retention and ingestion stress tests tomorrow at 03:00 UTC.

sam: thanks all — this is looking like a good mitigation path.

taylor: closing thread here — moving discussion and config diffs to the PR + RFC doc. cc: @devops @lee @anjali
